name: Sprunki Town
source:
Sprunki Town is a visual novel where you play as Grey, a gloomy Sprunki with a kind heart, who wants to uncover the mystery behind the strange events and phenomena shaking the town. Meet other Sprunki, dive into the investigation of Mard's disappearance, and discover the truth about the mysterious black Sprunki.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3436090/Sprunki_Town/]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Sprunki Town是一款视觉小说，你将扮演Grey，一个阴郁但心地善良的Sprunki，他想要揭开震撼小镇的奇怪事件和现象背后的谜团。与其他Sprunki见面，深入调查Mard失踪事件，并发现有关神秘黑人Sprunki的真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3436090/Sprunki_Town/]itch.io[/url]]
